title: Emit a gate on rails
statement: Given an input index $i_0$, a line index $\ell$, a gate, and a list of rails, return statements and an output rail as follows. For an AND gate, emit conjunction on the rails; for an OR gate, emit disjunction. For a NOT gate, emit the same statements as for conjunction and swap the two components of its output rail.
hypotheses_covered: A gate with a kind and a list of argument vertices
